nodes.name: Manual Trigger
nodes.notes: Start the deterministic fictional ingestion manually.

nodes.name: Demo Controls
nodes.notes: Set simulate_failure to true to exercise the controlled failure path.

nodes.name: Load Fictional Sample Data
nodes.notes: Self-contained copies of the committed sample files make the imported workflow portable. All values and dates are fictional and fixed.

nodes.name: Normalize Source Records
nodes.notes: Maps four fictional source shapes into stable operational field names. No business metrics or alerts are calculated here.

nodes.name: Aggregate Raw Operational Inputs
nodes.notes: Produces only the eleven source inputs accepted by DTCInputData. Python remains authoritative for calculated metrics and alert rules.

nodes.name: Simulate Failure?
nodes.notes: Routes to a controlled, persisted failure observation when the demo toggle is true.

nodes.name: Build Success Rows
nodes.notes: Builds fixed, idempotent Supabase rows. Calculated metric columns are deliberately omitted.

nodes.name: Upsert Metric Snapshot
nodes.notes: Trusted server-side write through Supabase REST. Credentials come from the n8n environment and are not exported.

nodes.name: Upsert Successful Workflow Run
nodes.notes: Persists observed execution metadata only. This node does not decide retries or approvals.

nodes.name: Build Controlled Failure Row
nodes.notes: Creates fixed failed-run metadata for demonstration. It does not write a metric snapshot or create an alert.

nodes.name: Upsert Failed Workflow Run
nodes.notes: Persists only the controlled failed-run observation. No alert row is written.
